notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.2
notes.content:
Thanks for waiting it has been some weeks since my last post, but I am happy to announce the Spanish support update along with a few changes to the game.

Notes:
-Spanish support
-Reduced game size
-Fix the story to make it clearer
-Adjusted Final Boss Health Points
-Fixed the issue of not being able to skip the intro.
-Fixed issue with transition after the main menu.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:

[*]

[*]
